system.description:
Where the Beast is an abstract rage for most Kindred, you make it terribly concrete: with a single glance you tear a victim's Beast loose so violently that it rends its way out of them.

Make eye contact, spend two Blood Traits and win a Social Challenge to awaken the victim's Beast so savagely that it claws free from within. The target suffers lethal damage equal to 10 minus their Humanity or Path rating. The power works on mortals and ghouls as well as vampires.
